combinations.name: Hone the edge
combinations.text: You wet the emery and draw the xiphos along it, stroke after stroke, until the bronze edge throws back the light.

combinations.name: Hone the point
combinations.text: A few patient passes on the Naxian stone and the leaf dagger comes to a needle point.

combinations.name: Anoint with Hydra venom
combinations.text: Like Herakles dipping his arrows, you let the black bile run along the blade. The bronze hisses where it touches.

combinations.name: Steep with dittany

check.failureText: The dittany scorches in the mortar before it can steep. The herb is wasted; the draught is unharmed.

combinations.text: You bruise the dittany in the Asklepian mortar and let it steep in the draught until it turns a deep, clean green.
